title: August and September screenshots moved to the E: drive: 483 MB freed, nothing deleted

owner_note.text: 4,248 old screenshots (483 MB) now live at E:/Projects/lew42/archive/sessions/2026/, every file checked by hash. Those two months went from 651 to 169 MB on disk. Every task record stayed, and so did every picture a page shows when it opens, so the Sessions page, search and old pages all still work. Undo: node Server/archive-sessions.mjs --undo --months 08,09. I chose this over removing the records from git: that would free 52 MB more and nothing in .git, but hide two months from search. Later, a copy on Cloudflare R2 would let a server read them: about $0 for two years, then $0.015/GB-month, after your Cloudflare login.
